properties.name: SAR avalanche inventory study area
properties.source: alecbiles-code/avalanche-inventory scripts/gee_processing.py PARAMS['bbox'] at commit d69692a
properties.meaning: Area analysed by the Sentinel-1 change detection (descending orbit; January 1 to April 30 scenes of 2022, 2023 and 2024). Outside this box nothing was analysed: no candidates there means no data, not no avalanches. Inside it, slopes outside 20 to 70 degrees and water were excluded in the manual step; layover, shadow and forest were not masked, so candidates there are less reliable.
